AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-17-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Scott Hughes.
Milton Katz, Esq. for Petitioner: Catherine Alexandra Vitlin, appearance waived by the court.
Declaration of Catherine Alexandra Vitlin in support of Petition for Change of Name, rec'd and filed in court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Catherine Alexandra Chandler.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-28-2006 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: F. Butler.
Milton Katz, Esq. for Petitioner: Catherine A. Vitlin, also present, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
After hearing the testimony of the Petitioner and at counsel's request, matter is taken off calendar.
Counsel to file an Amended OSC with the new hearing date, re-publication, and file declaration in support of the OSC.
Appearance of the Petitioner is waived, pending declaration in support.
